messages:
Alex: Heads-up: planning a cutover for the legacy v1 client compatibility agent (the sidecar that rewrites old envelope shapes). target window next Tuesday 02:00 UTC. want quick alignment on risk mitigations and telemetry we need.
Sophie: thanks. is this the agent that rewrites `old_payload` -> `envelope.v2` on the edge?
Alex: yep. it normalizes body + injects `X-Client-Version` header if missing. currently runs as an opt-in tenant sidecar. plan is to flip the opt-in default to enabled for 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks.
Devin: are we doing header negotiation or hard rewrite? re: downstream runtime expectations.
Alex: hard rewrite for now. runtime expects envelope v2 shapes. we keep a short fallback that returns 426 + `Upgrade-Required` if rewrite fails.
Tariq: we should avoid any synchronous fallback that increases tail latency. can we async-backfill and let request proceed with best-effort?
Sophie: second Tariq. if the agent calls the translator synchronously on every request we risk adding 20-50ms p95. need a cached translator for common prefixes.
Devin: caching keys? tenant-id + schema-hash + route?
Alex: proposal: local LRU keyed by `tenant_id|schema_sig|route_hash`. TTL 60s. miss triggers quick path: simple header-only rewrite (fast) and schedule background full normalization for next request.
Tariq: sounds reasonable. what's the failure mode? if background normalization fails repeatedly, we should flag the tenant and automatically roll them back to legacy handling.
Sophie: add metric: `compat_agent.rewrites_total`, `compat_agent.rewrites_failure`, `compat_agent.cache_hit` and `compat_agent.async_backfills_pending`. also emit `compat_migration_state` tag per-tenant (opted-in, partial, rolled-back).
Alex: will add. also adding a kill-switch: feature-flag `compat_agent.disable` at org level + per-tenant override. release-bot will wire the rollout percentages.
release-bot: release plan created: https://release.internal/r/5321 (canary tenants: team-logs, sandbox-payments). will auto-advance on green telemetry.
Devin: for canary success criteria: p95 latency delta < 5ms, error rate delta < 0.1% absolute, no increase in 5xx proxy errors. also track `validation_failures_per_minute` for the async backfill.
Sophie: test matrix: unit tests for rewrite rules, e2e using traffic-replay with legacy client samples, chaos job to drop translator responses to validate graceful degrade.
Tariq: what about observability traces? add span `compat_agent.rewrite` with attributes `tenant_id`, `rewrite_type` (fast/header/full), `cache_hit`. sample traces to SLOW_TRACES for further analysis.
Alex: agreed. also adding a small agent config snippet for ops:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: compat-agent-config
data:
  default_opt_in: "false"
  rollout_pct: "10"
  cache_ttl_seconds: "60"
  kill_switch_flag: "feature.compat_agent.disable"
```

Sophie: ops question: will the sidecar run in the same pod as edge-proxy or as a separate deployment?
Alex: same pod sidecar for tenant-local rewrite (lower network hop). but we also publish a cluster-wide translator service for heavy weight normalization jobs.
Devin: potential hotspot: cluster-translator CPU. plan autoscale based on `translator.queue_length` and `translator.cpu_util`. set max-replicas 8 initially.
Tariq: security note: rewriting payloads implies we touch PII. ensure KMS-key access for audit logs and redact secret headers. add audit events: `compat_agent.rewrite.audit` with redaction level.
Sophie: deprecation signal: will send header `X-Compat-Agent-Status: enabled|rolled-back` to clients and include a deprecation timeline in tenant-ops emails (30/60/90 days).
Alex: long-term: once 100% adopted, we will remove the legacy build artifact and delete `legacy-compat-agent` image. timeline target: 90 days after full roll.
Devin: one more: telemetry during rollout must be versioned so we can compare cohorts. attach `cohort=compat-vs-native` tag to relevant metrics.
Tariq: lgTM with the caveats above. recommend we run a 48h canary with synthetic load mirroring peak before advancing to 50%.
Alex: thanks all. I'll update the RFC and attach the metrics dashboard. ping me if you want to be in the canary list. :thumbsup:
